note.question: How does store brand spillover affect a retailer’s category management strategy?
note.overview: This paper studies a retailer’s category management strategy and interactions with its supply chain partners in a setting in which increasing the store brand (SB) market share in a focal category improves the retailer’s overall profitability by creating demand spillover to other categories. Unlike most category management research, which focuses on category profit maximization, our research incorporates SB spillover observed in practice into the retailer’s decision making. The paper analyzes a game-theoretic model with one retailer, one high-quality national brand (NB) manufacturer, and one low-quality NB manufacturer.
